_why: charger VAC pins 32 and 33 (same net, adjacent pins on the west side): pin 32 is tied to the planned C409/C509 link (capfix link3d via just west of pin 33) by a fixed 0.2 mm F.Cu track that leaves the pin westwards, so the pad centre of pin 32 stays the ratsnest end for the router's north-south PPHV join (a straight pin-to-pin bridge made the end a 'Track' between fine-pitch pins, which the router cannot reach) and the join reaches pin 33 / C409 / C509 too (m4 local route joined pin 32 only on port 2).
